claims: NATO is an intergovernmental military alliance.
NATO was formed in 1949.
NATO was formed to provide collective security against potential aggression, primarily from the Soviet Union (now Russia).
NATO consists of 32 member countries across North America and Europe.
As of 2024, NATO has 32 member countries.
The United States is a NATO member country.
Canada is a NATO member country.
The UK is a NATO member country.
France is a NATO member country.
Germany is a NATO member country.
NATO's core principle is mutual defense.
An attack on one NATO member is considered an attack on all.
NATO's purpose is to safeguard the freedom, security, and democratic values of its members.
Article 5 is the foundation of the NATO alliance.
Article 5 stipulates that NATO members agree to mutual defense in response to an attack.
Article 5 has been triggered only once.
Article 5 was triggered following the 9/11 attacks in 2001.
NATO decisions are made by consensus.
All NATO members must agree on actions.
NATO has no standing army.
NATO members contribute forces and resources to operations as needed.
NATO faces current security challenges including Russia's war against Ukraine, terrorism, and cyber threats.
